user.title: Mosquito Diffuser
user.description: Track the cartridge usage of a plug-in diffuser based on the outlet's on/off state.

data.name: Name
data.level_pct: Current cartridge level (%) — change it to calibrate
data.life_hours: Total active hours (used when 'Custom hours' with days = 0)
data.custom_days: Custom: duration in days (0 to use total hours above)
data.custom_hours_per_day: Custom: hours per day (e.g. 8 for a nightly diffuser)
data.schedule_enabled: Switch the outlet on a schedule

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: The integration switches the outlet automatically at these times. Usage only accrues while the outlet is on, so day presets assume continuous use; for night-rated refills use 'Custom hours' (nights × hours per night).

init.title: Mosquito Diffuser settings
init.description: Outlet, cartridge and schedule settings. The cartridge counter is kept when settings change — swap refills of a different size, then just change the cartridge type here.
